title: A couple at an infertility clinic
body: A couple has been unable to have a child after more than two years of unprotected sexual co-habitation. Tests at an infertility clinic show that the husband's semen is normal in sperm count and motility. The wife's ovaries do not produce ova, but her fallopian tubes are open and her uterus is healthy and able to support a pregnancy. A donor has agreed to provide ova. The doctor explains several assisted reproductive technologies to the couple. The couple says that, if possible, they would prefer a method in which fertilisation takes place inside the wife's own body rather than in the laboratory.
